text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin attempts a run that holds back 
her strength. However, she can't get the 
hang of it at all, only disrupting her own 
running... Perhaps it's time to reconsider 
the challenge itself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even when told this, Ines Fujin refused to 
listen. She insisted on showing her family 
that she wouldn't collapse even after a 
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And on the day of the Kikuka Sho, Ines 
Fujin makes a rare mistake related to her 
part-time job.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You helped smooth things over and 
prevented any major issues, but... she is 
shaken. To be there for her, give her your 
full support right now.
